## Inspired by our own feelings of wanderlust, every flavor is a love letter to the places we've been, the places we long to visit, and childhood memories.

### Each of our unique and original ice creams are formulated with all natural dairy, balanced butterfat, and minimal overrun for an indulgent experience that finishes clean on the palate.

New flavors, 
every month

metadata.description: Wanderlust Creamery is an artisanal ice cream brand known for globally-inspired, travel-themed flavors made with all-natural dairy. Visit our scoop shops across Los Angeles, Orange County, and San Diego, or book us for events and catering. Nationwide pint shipping available.
